text: At its meeting held April 7 and 8, 2021, City Council appointed Owais Lightwala to the TO Live Board of Directors for a term of office from April 9, 2021 to December 19, 2024 and until a successor is appointed. This new appointment fills the position previously held by Steven Levitan who resigned on February 12, 2021.
The Board of Directors of TO Live received the item for information.
